title: release-orchestration-weekly-handoff-notes
content:
Attendees: Amina (owner), Connor, Jae, Marta, SRE Oncall (brief), QA rep (joined for hotfix triage).

Context / purpose:
- Weekly handoff focused on active release windows, outstanding hotfix queue, and change-log reconciliations across dedicated/private hosts.
- Goal: ensure no surprises during Friday deploy window and that rollback playbooks are up-to-date for any mid-week hotfixes.

Agenda:
1) Quick status: current trains and known risks
2) Hotfix queue triage + prioritization
3) Change-log merge conflicts and release notes owner assignment
4) Canary health & fallback policy review
5) Action items and owners for next 7 days

1) Current trains / status notes:
- Mainline train: v2026.03.10 (canary started 03/09). Observed token-latency regression in small % of requests routed through gpu-pool-b. Recorded at 03/10 11:40 PST -> SRE measured 18% tail increase on 99.9th. Ticketed (RI-5612).
- Hotfix window: open for critical security fixes until 03/12 23:59 PST. Next scheduled maintenance: 03/19 (non-critical).
- Private deploys: Two customers (AcmeHealth, FinLedger) requested model pinning; rollout plan deferred pending compatibility test matrix.

Notes from runtime team (Jae):
- Preliminary root cause looks like a kernel selection fallback that increased memcpy on certain sequence lengths. Reproduced locally with sample workload; small patch improves path selection. Patch PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/998. If we push to canary, monitor 99th/99.9th.
- Action: hold canary expansion until patch validated in canary group 2 (gpu-pool-a only).

2) Hotfix queue (triage results):
- Hotfix candidates (ordered):
  * HF-2026-03-auth-latency (RI-5481) — urgent: auth token expiry miscalc causing 401 spikes for dedicated customers. Owner: Connor. Target: hotfix deploy 03/12 EOD.
  * HF-2026-03-embed-float-nan — medium: embedding job intermittently returns NaN for long sequences. Owner: QA flagged; tentative owner Marta.
  * HF-2026-03-docs-rollback — low: release notes formatting break, non-blocking. Owner: Amina.
- Decision: prioritize RI-5481 for hotfix train. All other items to weekend patch if no regressions.
- Note: communicate hotfix impact to CS for any customer outreach (Connor to draft message).

3) Change-log reconciliation and release notes:
- Problem: several PRs updated the same feature area causing change-log merge conflicts when generating release notes. Confluence release page has draft entries; need single owner to merge.
- Decision: Amina assigned to reconcile and produce the canonical notes for v2026.03.10 by 03/11 16:00 PST.
- Templates: use the Release Notes template on Confluence; include explicit migration steps for API consumer model pinning.

4) Canary health & fallback policy:
- Current canary coverage: 5% of read-only traffic, 2% of write-generation traffic. Canary group uses gpu-pool-b for heavier sequences.
- Observed anomalies: memory spike on long-context generation buckets during load tests.
- Fallback policy review: keep automatic fallback to v2026.02.27 active for <30s lat spikes. For persistent 5m+ regressions trigger automatic rollback.
- Decision: tighten canary SLOs for next expansion: require <15% relative increase on 99th latency vs baseline and no cache-miss rate >2%.

5) Action items (owners + due dates):
- Connor: implement and validate hotfix RI-5481 in staging, prepare emergency deploy checklist, notify CS draft — due 2026-03-12 18:00.
- Jae: promote kernel-selection patch to canary bucket (gpu-pool-a) and validate with synthetic workload — due 2026-03-12 22:00.
- Marta: reproduce embedding NaN issue with longer traces, attach minimal repro and open PR if confirmed — due 2026-03-14.
- Amina: finalize release notes and post to Confluence, include rollback links and runbook snippets — due 2026-03-11 16:00.
- SRE Oncall: prepare escalation contact list and monitor dashboards during Friday window — ongoing.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Should we expand canary pool to include private deployments for selected enterprise customers? Legal has flagged additional logging requirements; need Security input. Action: Amina to loop in Security by 03/13.
- How to better signal model-variant fallbacks to tenant-level analytics? TODO: product + infra brainstorm next week.

Post-meeting quick notes (raw):
- Quick rollback sanity check: ensure service accounts for rollback scripts have the same IAM as deployer. Connor to confirm.
- Reminder: coordinate with Console team for per-route dashboard tags before canary expand.
- If HF RI-5481 causes any data plane restarts, communicate immediately to Customer Success.

Next handoff meeting: 2026-03-12 09:00 PST (short sync) — primary goal: confirm hotfix state and canary health.

Attachments / refs (handy links):
- Runbook: confluence.redwood.ai/display/RELEASE/Release+Orchestration+Runbook
- Hotfix checklist: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/blob/main/hotfix-checklist.md
- Observability board: internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/rls-canary-health

Notes-to-self: keep this doc light and iterative; move finalized summaries to the Confluence release page when done.
